assistant.hello_anon: Hi, I'm Veyra. How can I help?

r.greeting: Hi {{name}}! What would you like to sort out?
r.greeting_anon: Hi! What would you like to sort out?
r.help: I can plan your day, find overdue tasks, review spending against your budgets, check bills, and add things for you — try a suggestion below.
r.plan_clear: Your day is clear — nothing scheduled and no tasks due. A good moment for something you've been putting off.
r.plan_slots_one: You have {{events}} events and {{tasks}} open tasks today. I found a free slot for your most important task — want me to schedule it?
r.plan_slots_other: You have {{events}} events and {{tasks}} open tasks today. I found free time for your top {{count}} tasks — want me to schedule them?
r.plan_free: You have {{events}} events and {{tasks}} open tasks today, with some free time left. Everything important already has a time.
r.plan_full: Today is full — {{events}} events and {{tasks}} open tasks, with no gaps of 45 minutes or more before 6pm. Consider moving something to tomorrow.
r.overdue_one: One task is overdue. Want me to move it to today?
r.overdue_other: {{count}} tasks are overdue. Want me to move them to today?
r.expenses_none: No income or spending recorded this month yet.
r.expenses_ok: You've spent {{spent}} this month, mostly on {{top}}. Everything is within budget.
r.expenses_near: You've spent {{spent}} this month. {{near}} is close to its budget.
r.expenses_over: You've spent {{spent}} this month. {{over}} is over budget.
r.bills_upcoming_one: Nothing due right now. Here's what's next.
r.bills_upcoming_other: Nothing due right now. Here's what's next.
r.tasks_none: You have no open tasks. Enjoy it.
r.tasks: Today: {{today}} open, {{done}} done. Overdue: {{late}}. Coming up this week: {{week}}.
r.complete_none: I couldn't find an open task matching “{{target}}”.
r.emails: I can't read your email yet — Gmail support is on the roadmap. I can help with your tasks, calendar, money and notes.
r.capture_other: I found {{count}} things to add. Want me to add them?
r.unknown: I'm not sure how to help with that yet. Want me to save it as a note? Or try one of these.
